closed_reason: Not reproducible — verified FALSE by direct source read and live test run during FEAT-600 code review. Actual code (producers/live.py:34-49) builds a kwargs dict and only adds database_type for the generic SQLToolkit fallback branch, with an explicit comment addressing exactly this collision risk. git log shows this file was touched by exactly one commit (de37b3f1b, TASK-3683) — never patched for this bug. Ran test_live_producer.py::test_toolkit_choice for postgres/bigquery/sqlite — all 3 pass. Manually invoked toolkit_for() for both postgres and bigquery configs — both construct cleanly with correct database_type. Hallucinated finding, independently duplicated by a second reviewer as issue:4cecdcffd46e.

closed_reason: Root cause found and fixed; NOT a uvloop quirk (venv ran uvloop 0.22.1, never 0.21.0). Importing parrot makes navconfig chdir pytest to the primary checkout; the harness inherited the relative PYTHONPATH=packages/ai-parrot/src and re-resolved it against that cwd, so it imported the PRIMARY checkout's pre-fix _create_process() (no stdin=DEVNULL) while the hotfix existed only in its worktree. Reproduced: pre-fix launcher under uvloop 0.22.1 gives grandchild fd0 = harness pipe, fixed launcher gives /dev/null; old test false-passes from a pre-fix worktree, new test fails there. Fix: harness pinned to the session's codex.py (absolute PYTHONPATH + samefile guard), xfail removed; 39 passed in the task's verification command, and the test passes in the full dev_loop session.
title: test_spawn_child_gets_eof_with_parent_stdin_open fails only under the full pytest session (uvloop fd-accounting quirk)
